title: A lesson's page (lesson.json), format sigrix-lesson/1
description: The page a lesson bundle carries beside its media, which a learning site imports as the lesson's page: its address, its text, where it is filed, and the same video on YouTube. A reader ignores a member it does not know and refuses a format it does not know. Some rules are about the bundle and its pack rather than the page, and no JSON Schema can state them; SPEC.md lists them: a bundle holds its video beside its lesson.json and at most one cover, and a pack names a slug once.
$comment: A pattern that holds a whole value ends in (?![\s\S]), which is the end of the text in every regular expression engine; $ is not, since in some it also matches before a final line break.

format.description: The format and its major version. A reader refuses a format it does not know.

slug.description: The lesson's address on the site, /learn/<slug>: lowercase letters and digits, in words joined by single hyphens, such as notebook-lesson-1-your-first-note. An import updates the lesson already at that address, if there is one.

title.description: The page's title, which is not blank.

summary.description: A sentence or two under the title, and the page's description for search. Not blank.

category.description: The section of the learning site the page is filed under.

tags.description: The tags the site lists the page under, at /learn/tag/<tag>: at most eight, each once, and each lowercase letters and digits in words joined by single hyphens, at most 32 characters.

body_markdown.description: The page's text under its video, in Markdown: at most 16,384 characters, half the 32,768 UTF-16 code units a learning site keeps of it, so that it fits whatever its characters are (an emoji is two code units).

read_minutes.description: How long the page takes, in whole minutes. Without it, the site takes the video's length to the nearest minute.

youtube_url.description: The same video on YouTube, which the page links to: its watch address, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<id>, or its short link, https://youtu.be/<id>. Left out until the video is there, so an import keeps a link the page already has.
